name: InvoiceFlow Error Handler
description: Captures unattended workflow failures, classifies retryability, redacts sensitive numeric data, and records a simulated operations alert through the InvoiceFlow API.

nodes.name: Capture error
nodes.notes: Creates a bounded, structured failure payload from n8n execution context.

nodes.name: Classify retryability
nodes.notes: Separates retryable infrastructure failures from fatal business errors.

nodes.name: Redact payload
nodes.notes: Redacts long account-like digit sequences before the simulated alert is stored.
